description: VR mod for SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE (Steam): play it in a SteamVR headset with motion controllers, hands and grab-and-throw.
notes: SHMCD-VR is installed into your SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE folder (found through Steam), with BepInEx 5 (x86).
Play from Steam's normal entry for the game: it starts in VR, straight into the game, and is listed in SteamVR's VR tab after Steam next restarts.
Upgrading from 0.1: Python is no longer needed. Remove the old 'SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE VR' entry from Steam if you added it (right-click > Manage > Remove non-Steam game).
Game in an unusual place? Set the SHMCDVR_GAMEDIR environment variable to its folder and install again.

script: if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'SHMCD-VR setup failed (see the log above).' }
# On update the new version's installer simply installs over the old one; only a real uninstall removes the mod.
